# Fintilla

> Fintilla is building an AI-powered platform to help lenders assess small businesses with limited financial records. Borrowers answer questions in a guided session on their own phone, and Fintilla turns what they share into an assessment, with evidence and reasoning.

- Company: Fintilla Pte. Ltd., a Singapore-based team with experience building fintech businesses and AI platforms across Asia
- Contact: sherrey@fintilla.com

- [Home](https://www.fintilla.com/): how Fintilla helps lenders see beyond the books
